edits.new:
This bidang usaha is allocated to Koperasi and UMKM under Perpres 49/2021's Lampiran II (p.15, entry 48, sub-row "Hotel Melati", ex-KBLI 2020 55120), so a PT PMA cannot register it. The steps below are the Koperasi/UMKM registration route, not a PMA one.
1. **NIB via OSS** — register on oss.go.id as a Koperasi/UMKM entity, select this code, issued automatically (1–3 days)
2. **NIB + Standard Certificate** (Micro / Small / Medium, Medium-Low risk) — Authority: Bupati/Walikota — automatic
3. **NIB + Standard Certificate** (Small / Medium / Large, Medium-Low risk) — Authority: Bupati/Walikota — automatic
4. **NIB + Standard Certificate** (Small / Medium / Large, Medium-High risk) — Authority: Gubernur — 14 Hari
5. **Obtain Laik Sehat (SLS) health-ready certificate** — post-license obligation
6. **Submit periodic activity reports** — post-license obligation
7. **Comply with applicable standards** — post-license obligation

**Authority by scale:**
Micro / Small / Medium: **Bupati/Walikota** (Otomatis) · Small / Medium / Large: **Bupati/Walikota** (Otomatis) · Small / Medium / Large: **Gubernur** (14 Hari)

**PMA:** Closed to foreign investment — domestic entities only. Perpres 10/2021 Lampiran II (as replaced by 49/2021) allocates non-star hotel operation (the Hotel Melati class) to Koperasi and UMKM; a PT PMA cannot hold equity in this activity.
